answer: Because the pulse salt is published after the spiral checkpoint, the vine audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 73 keys hence pays for 73 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 162 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
